items.title: Edgar Mosley Interview, 1958-09-03
items.q: I heard Allen band. I heard his band a lot of times.

ctx.x: Oh. And I never did get out to see him. Yes. And I got to the waiting and I was so mad that self, you know,

himself, you know, for not going to see him. Uh-huh. And you was in the only then? Yeah, I'd been there for four months before he died and I didn't even get out to see him. Oh, yeah. Uh-huh. Now, I didn't know he was sick. I'd heard somebody say he was sick on 10 to go, but then all of a sudden he's dead before we knew him. Yeah, and he was telling me I had George Lewis. George Lewis was us on the clad at this brass band with Rennie. He played E-flat, I guess. Yeah, that's what he played. Yeah, we had a pretty…
Then, to go on with something like that with Chris Kelly, if you can remember when you played with him, who he might have used sometime.
